title: Naito: rejected Stardust Genius to El Ingobernable
summary: Tetsuya Naito’s first attempt to become New Japan’s leading hero fails to connect. A changed attitude and Los Ingobernables de Japon turn rejection into a very different route to the championship.

chapters.title: The promised coronation fails
chapters.result: Okada defeats Naito in their IWGP title match.
chapters.context: A fan vote had placed the Intercontinental match above them. Naito loses both the title opportunity and his claim to headline the Dome.

chapters.title: Los Ingobernables delivers the title
chapters.result: Naito defeats Okada for his first IWGP heavyweight championship.
chapters.context: SANADA’s debut and LIJ’s interference help the transformed challenger succeed where his earlier heroic persona failed.
